description: Source code for TbMsgGeneratorNode class, a component in Thingsboard's rule engine that periodically generates messages using scripting, with support for configuration upgrades and lifecycle management.

classes.name: TbMsgGeneratorNode
classes.description: A rule engine node that generates messages periodically, supporting scripting and configuration upgrades.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the node with configuration, sets up scripting engine, and schedules message generation.

methods.name: onPartitionChangeMsg
methods.description: Handles partition change messages to update generator state.

methods.name: updateGeneratorState
methods.description: Updates the internal state of the generator based on current context and configuration.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Processes incoming messages, triggers message generation if conditions are met.

methods.name: scheduleTickMsg
methods.description: Schedules the next tick message to trigger message generation after a delay.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a message asynchronously using scripting engine.

methods.name: getOriginatorId
methods.description: Determines the originator EntityId based on configuration.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources and stops the generator.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Handles configuration upgrades from older versions.
